criteria.name: Empathy and Emotional Intelligence
criteria.description: Did the agent acknowledge the customer's frustration and show genuine empathy for repeated issues?

criteria.name: Problem Diagnosis
criteria.description: Did the agent effectively assess the technical issue and avoid repeating failed troubleshooting steps?

criteria.name: Solution Efficiency
criteria.description: Did the agent quickly escalate to appropriate next steps rather than prolonging the issue?

criteria.name: Flexibility and Accommodation
criteria.description: Did the agent work within the customer's constraints (scheduling, availability)?

criteria.name: Transparency
criteria.description: Were explanations clear about costs, warranty coverage, and what to expect next?

criteria.name: Issue Resolution
criteria.description: Did the agent successfully schedule a solution and provide clear follow-up information?
